mechanism_card.hypothesis: Removing 10% lowest-ranked (nearest-catalogue) dots reduces FP weight >0.2*DTI while preserving TP kernel credit
mechanism_card.mechanism: Tversky denominator dominated by S-M; low-ranked dots contribute ~0.2 FP penalty with minimal T due to proximity to masked faults; their removal raises DTI
mechanism_card.non_fault_mimic: Clustered alluvial fan apex distributaries that mimic fault scarps but lack deep continuity; our distance ranking conflates them with true blind faults near known systems
mechanism_card.falsifier: If live DTI drops >0.01, low-ranked near-cat dots were providing relay-hardening kernel overlap bridging to blind segments
